record.title: Reconcile CI maintenance and finalize reusable tooling handoff
record.intent: Close the observed CI maintenance issue and retain a clean usable toolkit checkpoint.
requirements: Independently inspect the workflow change and remote results, close the bounded task batch and push the handoff.
Retain explicit offline library and evidence limits; defer additional generic features until a concrete procedure needs them.
acceptance: The checkout is clean and pushed with supported passing CI and no unresolved task in this batch.
